reasons: High-severity credit-event news in the last 48h (+15 pts): Oracle invokes 'force majeure' on Blue Owl's $165B Project Jupiter data center, stock sinks 5-7%
Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.73% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +3bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Loans outperforming HY by 1.5pp over 10d — that HY weakness is more rates than credit.

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 146 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 90 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.5 sits at the 17th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.9, so implied carries +4.6 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Oracle invokes 'force majeure' on Blue Owl's $165B Project Jupiter data center, stock sinks 5-7%
items.note: Oracle sent a force-majeure notice seeking the right to defer payments if the Stargate-adjacent New Mexico campus misses its 2028 open date after regulators repeatedly denied a required pipeline right-of-way; the $18B of debt already backing the project is trading at stressed levels — a realized, forced protective action, not commentary.

items.headline: Blue Owl-sponsored, CoreWeave-leased 'Digital Drive' data center closes $1.1B junk bond at 9.25%, BB-
items.note: The five-year notes priced at 98.5c to yield 9.25%, roughly 2.7pp above comparable debt, with S&P rating the deal BB- and flagging 'exposure to a single, speculative-grade tenant' as the key risk — concrete evidence lenders are pricing in real CoreWeave counterparty risk even as the deal got done.

items.headline: Jane Street-linked Zenith Arc data-center bonds keep souring, secondary yield near 11.3% a month after 9% pricing
items.note: The $2.25B BB-rated Zenith Arc green notes (Oklahoma data center leased to Jane Street) priced near 9% in August and are still trading markedly wider in FINRA data as of Sept 23-24, a persistent markdown signal for non-investment-grade AI data-center paper rather than a one-day blip.

items.headline: Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia bond spreads widen 15-19bps as AI-linked issuance scales up
items.note: Alphabet's spread widened from 56 to 71bps as deal size grew from $1.25B to $3.5B, with Meta and Nvidia seeing similar 15-19bps widening on $4B offerings; AI-linked issuer spreads (~115bps) now trade well wide of the broad IG market (~78bps) — a market-wide repricing of AI infrastructure credit risk, not a single-name story.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
